scripts.dev: nodemon --signal SIGTERM --watch package.json --watch pnpm-lock.yaml --watch turbo.json --exec "turbo dev"
scripts.dev:studio: nodemon --signal SIGTERM --watch apps/studio --watch packages --ignore apps/studio/.output --ext ts,tsx,js,mjs,json,css --exec "pnpm --filter @beam-studio/studio dev"
scripts.dev:api: nodemon --signal SIGTERM --watch apps/api/src --watch apps/api/package.json --watch packages --ext ts,tsx,js,mjs,json --exec "pnpm --filter @beam-studio/api dev"
scripts.dev:studio-api: nodemon --signal SIGTERM --watch apps/studio/src --watch apps/api/src --watch apps/studio/package.json --watch apps/api/package.json --ext ts,tsx,json,css --exec "pnpm -r --parallel --filter @beam-studio/studio --filter @beam-studio/api run dev"
scripts.dev:orchestrator: nodemon --signal SIGTERM --watch apps/orchestrator/src --watch apps/orchestrator/package.json --watch packages --ext ts,tsx,js,mjs,json --exec "pnpm --filter @beam-studio/orchestrator dev"
scripts.dev:worker: nodemon --signal SIGTERM --watch apps/worker/src --watch apps/worker/package.json --watch packages --ext ts,tsx,js,mjs,json --exec "pnpm --filter @beam-studio/worker dev"
scripts.dev:mcp: nodemon --signal SIGTERM --watch apps/mcp-server/src --watch apps/mcp-server/package.json --watch packages --ext ts,tsx,js,mjs,json --exec "pnpm --filter @beam-studio/mcp-server dev"
scripts.dev:desktop: nodemon --signal SIGTERM --watch apps/desktop/src --watch apps/desktop/package.json --watch packages --ext ts,tsx,js,mjs,json,css --exec "pnpm --filter @beam-studio/desktop dev"
